note: PMIDs adjudicated as attached to the WRONG CLAIM. Every one resolves to a real PubMed record, which is exactly why they survived four gates. This registry is PERSISTENT on purpose: once the live audit is clean it reports nothing, and a verdict that disappears when the defect is fixed cannot stop the defect returning, nor label the record on the published verification page. Extended 2026-08-24 with 10 builder-literal miscitations found by audit_builder_title_agreement.py, the first gate in this repo to compare an ASSERTED title against the title PubMed returns; four of them had passed every topic screen because the wrong paper was also a diabetes paper. 2026-08-24: added claim_scoped_verdicts for PMIDs that were misattached at one site but remain correctly cited at another; a PMID-keyed verdict cannot express that distinction and applying one anyway would replace a false citation with a false badge.
